scenario_context: Performance degradation (high latency), not full outage. Do not claim root cause or guess ETA. Offer workaround, collect diagnostics, set update cadence.

customer_profile.opening_message: Pages take 15–20 seconds. Is the system down?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent offers workaround + sets next update time (no ETA guessing)

checkpoints.description: State investigating; describe as degradation if appropriate; avoid root-cause claims
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Don’t label outage/root cause without confirmation.

checkpoints.description: Ask minimal diagnostics (region, time started, features impacted, client info)
Offer at least one immediate workaround
Set update cadence and a next update time (no ETA guessing)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Commit to updates instead of an ETA.

success_summary: Degradation comms: workaround + diagnostics + update cadence without ETA guessing.
